summary.en: Four-year-old with fever up to 102 and cough for two days. Stop Combiflam; Calpol 7.5 ml when fever is above 100 with at least six hours between doses, and Ambrodil S 5 ml twice a day for five days. Give plenty of water and warm soup, nothing cold, return in three days if no relief.

follow_up.reason: if no relief from fever and cough

instructions.text: Stop Combiflam, do not give it to the child
Calpol only when fever is above 100
Keep at least six hours between Calpol doses
Give plenty of water and warm soup, nothing cold
